title: Terminals in their own window
summary: The desktop app gets a dedicated Terminal window, and you can share apps with your organization.

highlights.title: The Terminal window
highlights.body: Open a Terminal window in the desktop app with terminals from every Matrix computer, plus local terminals on your own machine.

highlights.title: Share apps with your organization
highlights.body: Share an app with your organization. It runs on your computer, and teammates open it in the browser or the desktop app.

items.text: A private AI activity dashboard shows your agent history, including history from your Mac.
Links in the mobile terminal open in the browser.
Stronger protection for the web requests your Matrix computer makes.
